s: Amsterdam (a city and municipality of North Holland, Netherlands; the capital city of the Netherlands)

Amsel.et: From Middle High German amsel, from Old High German amsala, from Proto-West Germanic *amslā.

s: a native or inhabitant of Amsterdam
a municipality of Lower Austria, Austria
a female native or inhabitant of Amsterdam, Netherlands
certain groups of people can be recognized by their typical or common characteristics
am Schilde erkennt man die Gilde.et: Literally, “one recognizes a guild by its shield”.

s: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see am, Start.
to (also) be taking part, to be around, to be ready to take something on
